title: awesome-multi-vectors-retrieval is now live
description: I released awesome-multi-vectors-retrieval, a comprehensive and continuously updated collection of papers covering topics in multi-vector retrieval. Stars and contributions are welcome.

title: ARTEA enters the VLDB 2027 revision round
description: ARTEA, our work on a theoretically guaranteed hierarchical graph index, has advanced to the VLDB 2027 revision round after receiving three minor-revision recommendations.
